description: A Large-Scale Image Repository for Automated Pavement Distress Analysis and Degradation Trend Prediction is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Hanlin Yang et al. In recent years, automated detection technologies for large-scale pavement distress have become a focal point of research in the transportation sector. With the rapid advancement of deep learning technologies, data-driven artificial intelligence recognition algorithms have gradually emerged as the industry mainstream. The effectiveness of such algorithms largely depends on the reliability and quantity of the samples. Coverage: not stated; published in 2025. Formats: Excel, Image. The data are held in Science Data Bank and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 35910851959 bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC0-1.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
